methodology.base: Base unit enters next open after the PB-V4 source signal, then exits only by its own -7% hard stop, close-based MA20+structure failure, or latest close. PB-V4 exit date is not read.
methodology.addon_entry: PB-V20 MA20-retest add-on timing is kept, but the scan end is the available data end instead of the PB-V4 base exit date.
methodology.addon_exit: Add-on units use the PB-V22 loose structural stop: exit only after close below both MA20 and the signal-to-confirmation structure low, next open; plus a close-based 15% catastrophic stop.
methodology.structure_low: Current structure low is min(low) from signal date through the confirmation candle, inclusive. It is a window low, not a swing-low/ABC parser.
methodology.validation: Chronological 60/20/20 and deterministic stock-level 60/20/20 splits are reported.
